vibe: Follows how the class builds and argues about agents, and picks up ideas along the way.
lines: Hi, I'm Yufeng! I'm in the class this term, following the agent debates.
My site just says welcome for now. The real action is in everyone else's builds.
It's fun hearing all the agent debates from the back row.
Every week someone builds something I didn't expect.
I'm here to learn how people think about agents for cognitive augmentation.
